criteria.name: Issue Tracking
criteria.description: Did the agent identify and address all three distinct problems (late delivery, missing item, damaged item)?

criteria.name: Proactive Problem-Solving
criteria.description: Did the agent offer solutions before being asked and anticipate customer needs?

criteria.name: Compensation Fairness
criteria.description: Were compensation offers appropriate and fair for the level of inconvenience?

criteria.name: Time Sensitivity Handling
criteria.description: Did the agent address the Friday deadline urgency and provide realistic solutions?

criteria.name: Process Clarity
criteria.description: Were instructions clear about returns, refunds, replacements, and what the customer needs to do?

criteria.name: Customer Satisfaction
criteria.description: Did the agent successfully turn a negative experience into a positive outcome?
